def build_application(root, database, observe=True):
    database.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    service = Gallery(database, root / "bo_stategraph/project.json")
    app = create_app(service)
    adapter = None
    if observe:
        try:
            from integrations.bo_adapter import BOAdapter
            from integrations.bo_web import bo_attach
            adapter = BOAdapter(root, database)
            adapter.graph.bo_require_definition(service.machine.definition)
            bo_attach(app, adapter, root)
            service.bo, service.build_id = adapter.port, adapter.build_id
        except Exception as error:
            if adapter is not None: adapter.bo_close()
            adapter = None
            print(f"Observer unavailable; business remains available: {type(error).__name__}: {error}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    return app, service, adapter

    app.secret_key = secrets.token_hex(32)
    app.config.update(GALLERY=service, MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH=16 * 1024 * 1024, SESSION_COOKIE_HTTPONLY=True, SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE="Lax")

    app.register_error_handler(DomainError, domain_error)

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8842)
    parser.add_argument("--core", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--database", default="work/gallery.sqlite")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    app, service, adapter = build_application(root, root / args.database, not args.core)
    server = make_server("127.0.0.1", args.port, app, threaded=True)
    print(f"Gallery URL: http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/", flush=True)
    print(f"Graph URL: http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/graph" if adapter else "Graph URL: unavailable (business-only mode)", flush=True)
    try: server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt: pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()
        if adapter is not None: adapter.bo_close()

def upload(self, actor: str, filename: str, data: bytes) -> dict:
        role = self.authorize(actor, "uploader")
        checked = self.inspect_image(data)
        if not checked["valid"]:
            self.bo.record("invalid_file", "reject", {"format": checked["format"]}, {"status": 415, "created": False})
            raise DomainError(415, "Only actual PNG or JPEG images are accepted")
        ident = uuid.uuid4().hex
        context = {"format": checked["format"], "uploader": actor}
        change = self.machine.transition(self.machine.definition["initial"], "submit", context, {"role": role})
        digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        with self.connect() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            db.execute("INSERT INTO images VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (ident, actor, filename[:180], checked["format"], checked["width"], checked["height"], digest, data, change["state"], 1, self.build_id))
            message_id = self.notify(db, ident)
            db.execute("INSERT INTO journal(image_id,event,previous,state,revision) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)", (ident, "submit", change["before"], change["state"], 1))
        event_id = self.bo.record("upload", "commit", {"actor": actor, "filename": filename[:180], "byte_count": len(data)}, {"id": ident, "state": change["state"], "revision": 1, "sha256": digest}, ident)
        self.bo.record("message", "commit", {"image_id": ident}, {"recipient": "reviewer", "message_id": message_id}, ident, ((event_id, "flow"),))
        return {"id": ident, "state": change["state"]}

"""Execute real application cases and independently read SQL/HTTP effects."""
from io import BytesIO
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sqlite3
import uuid
from PIL import Image
from app.service import Gallery
from app.web import create_app
from integrations.bo_adapter import BOAdapter
from integrations.bo_web import bo_attach

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def image_bytes(fmt="PNG"):
    stream = BytesIO()
    Image.new("RGB", (48, 32), (78, 119, 101)).save(stream, format=fmt)
    return stream.getvalue()

def csrf(client):
    page = client.get("/login")
    return re.search(rb'name="csrf" value="([^"]+)"', page.data).group(1).decode()

def login(client, username, password=None):
    token = csrf(client)
    return client.post("/login", data={"csrf":token,"username":username,"password":password or {"uploader":"upload-demo-2026","reviewer":"review-demo-2026"}.get(username,"bad")})

def session_csrf(client):
    with client.session_transaction() as session:
        return session["csrf"]

def upload(client, data=None, filename="test.png"):
    return client.post("/upload", data={"csrf":session_csrf(client),"file":(BytesIO(image_bytes() if data is None else data),filename)}, content_type="multipart/form-data")

def sql_snapshot(database):
    with sqlite3.connect(database) as db:
        db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        rows = [dict(row) for row in db.execute("SELECT id,state,revision,build_id,format,uploader FROM images ORDER BY rowid")]
        messages = db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages").fetchone()[0]
        recipients = [row[0] for row in db.execute("SELECT recipient FROM messages ORDER BY rowid")]
    return rows, messages, recipients

def execute_case(case, mode, parent=None):
    folder = parent or ROOT/"work/cases"/uuid.uuid4().hex
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    database = folder/f"{case}-{mode}.sqlite"
    adapter = BOAdapter(ROOT,database,mode=mode,recording_dir=folder/(case+"-"+mode+"-recordings"))
    service = Gallery(database,ROOT/"bo_stategraph/project.json",adapter.port,adapter.build_id)
    adapter.graph.bo_require_definition(service.machine.definition)
    app = create_app(service)
    bo_attach(app,adapter,ROOT)
    client=app.test_client()
    client.get("/")
    status=200
    if case == "bad_login":
        status=login(client,"uploader","wrong").status_code
    elif case == "anonymous_upload_denied":
        csrf(client)
        status=upload(client).status_code
    elif case == "reviewer_upload_denied":
        login(client,"reviewer")
        status=upload(client).status_code
    else:
        login(client,"uploader")
        client.get("/upload")
        if case in {"non_image","spoof_extension"}:
            status=upload(client,b"This is not an image", "image.png" if case=="spoof_extension" else "notes.txt").status_code
        elif case == "unsupported_gif":
            status=upload(client,image_bytes("GIF"),"pretend.jpg").status_code
        else:
            content=image_bytes("JPEG" if case=="reject_jpeg" else "PNG")
            response=upload(client,content,"image.jpg" if case=="reject_jpeg" else "image.png")
            status=response.status_code
            rows,_,_=sql_snapshot(database)
            ident=rows[0]["id"]
            if case == "uploader_review_denied":
                status=client.post("/review/"+ident,data={"csrf":session_csrf(client),"decision":"approve"}).status_code
            elif case == "private_image_hidden":
                client.post("/logout",data={"csrf":session_csrf(client)})
                status=client.get("/image/"+ident).status_code
            elif case != "pending_hidden":
                client.post("/logout",data={"csrf":session_csrf(client)})
                login(client,"reviewer")
                client.get("/messages")
                preview=client.get("/image/"+ident)
                assert preview.data==content, "Reviewer preview must return actual uploaded bytes"
                status=client.post("/review/"+ident,data={"csrf":session_csrf(client),"decision":"reject" if case=="reject_jpeg" else "approve"}).status_code
                client.get("/messages")
                if case == "repeat_review":
                    status=client.post("/review/"+ident,data={"csrf":session_csrf(client),"decision":"reject"}).status_code
                if case == "approve_png":
                    client.post("/logout",data={"csrf":session_csrf(client)})
                    assert client.get("/image/"+ident).data==content, "Public image bytes differ"
    public=app.test_client().get("/")
    rows,messages,recipients=sql_snapshot(database)
    observations={"items":len(rows),"messages":messages,"recipients":recipients,"public_count":public.data.count(b"<figure>"),"status":status,"last_state":rows[-1]["state"] if rows else ""}
    adapter.pins.flush()
    projection=adapter.bo_projection()
    events=adapter.history.snapshot()
    export=adapter.graph.bo_export(runtime={"machine":projection["machine"],"events":events})
    mapping_checks=[{"id":case+":"+mode+":ids","source":"independent SQL images.id","projection":"bo_instances.instance_id","actual":[r["id"] for r in rows],"mapped":[i["observed"]["instance_id"] for i in projection["instances"]]}]
    if case == "approve_png" and mode == "on":
        observed=next(e for e in events if e["node"]=="review" and e["phase"]=="commit")
        mapping_checks.append({"id":"approval-state","source":"independent SQL images.state","projection":"review commit outputs.state","actual":rows[0]["state"],"mapped":observed["outputs"]["state"]})
        msg=next(e for e in events if e["node"]=="message")
        mapping_checks.append({"id":"message-recipient","source":"independent SQL messages.recipient","projection":"message commit outputs.recipient","actual":recipients[0],"mapped":msg["outputs"]["recipient"]})
    result={"case":case,"mode":mode,"events":events,"observations":observations,"authority_rows":rows,"projection":projection,"health":adapter.pins.health(),"port_errors":adapter.port.errors,"database":str(database)}
    adapter.bo_close()
    return result,mapping_checks,export

def main():
    plan=json.loads((ROOT/"mapping.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    folder=ROOT/"work/cases"/uuid.uuid4().hex
    runs,checks=[],[]
    selected=None
    for case in plan["cases"]:
        for mode in plan["modes"]:
            run,mapping,export=execute_case(case,mode,folder)
            runs.append(run)
            checks.extend(mapping)
            if {"case":case,"mode":mode}==plan["export"]: selected=export
    model=json.loads((ROOT/"bo_stategraph/project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["model"]
    payload={"build_id":selected["build_id"],"machine":model["machine"],"runs":runs,"mapping_checks":checks,"stategraph_export":selected}
    print(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False))

if __name__=="__main__": main()

"""Bounded observation adapter using the frozen Python public implementation."""
from collections import deque
from copy import deepcopy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
import threading
import uuid
from bo_stategraph import BOStateGraph
from app.ports import BOPort
from observer_runtime.behavior_model import capture, check
from observer_runtime.semantic_probe import Pins, Trace
from observer_runtime.bo_retention import EventHistory
from observer_runtime.recording_session import Recordings

class BOAdapter:
    def __init__(self, root, database, mode="on", capacity=2048, recording_dir=None):
        self.root, self.database = Path(root), str(database)
        self.project = json.loads((self.root / "bo_stategraph/project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.model = self.project["model"]
        self.manifest = capture(self.root, self.model)
        self.build_id = self.manifest["build_id"]
        self.mode, self.metadata = mode, {}
        self.lock = threading.RLock()
        self.history = EventHistory(path=self.root / "work/runtime/events.jsonl", limits={"memory_events": 5000})
        self.frames = deque(maxlen=500)
        self.graph = BOStateGraph(self.model, build_id=self.build_id, mode="drive", instance_provider=self.bo_machine)
        self.pins = Pins(self.model, self.build_id, enabled=mode != "off", sink=self.bo_sink, capacity=capacity)
        self.port = BOPort(self.bo_record)
        self.recordings = Recordings(recording_dir or self.root / "work/recordings", self.bo_view,
            {p: (self.root / p).read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in self.model["source_files"] if p.endswith(".py")},
            scope_setter=self.pins.bo_set_scope, event_source=self.history, interval=0.2)

    def bo_rows(self):
        with sqlite3.connect(self.database, timeout=10) as db:
            db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            try:
                return [dict(row) for row in db.execute("SELECT id,state,revision,build_id,format,uploader FROM images ORDER BY rowid")]
            except sqlite3.OperationalError:
                return []

    def bo_configuration(self, row):
        return {"attempt": row["id"], "phase": row["state"], "state_revision": row["revision"],
            "revision": row["revision"], "param_version": 1, "journal": [],
            "run_build_id": row["build_id"], "context": {"format": row["format"], "uploader": row["uploader"]}, "source_status": "current"}

    def bo_machine(self):
        configurations = [self.bo_configuration(row) for row in self.bo_rows()]
        return {"configurations": configurations, "current": configurations[-1]["phase"] if configurations else None, "journal": []}

    def bo_record(self, node, phase, inputs, outputs, entity, depends):
        if self.mode == "fault": raise OSError("Injected observer transport failure")
        call_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
        meta = None
        if phase == "commit" and "revision" in outputs:
            with sqlite3.connect(self.database, timeout=10) as db:
                db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
                row = db.execute("SELECT j.image_id AS id,j.state,j.revision,i.build_id,i.format,i.uploader FROM journal j JOIN images i ON i.id=j.image_id WHERE j.image_id=? AND j.revision=?", (entity, outputs["revision"])).fetchone()
            if row:
                cfg = self.bo_configuration(dict(row))
                meta = {"revision": row["revision"], "machine": {"state_revision": row["revision"], "configurations": [cfg], "journal": [], "current": row["state"]},
                    "authority": {"entity": entity, "state": row["state"], "basis": {"param_version": 1}, "parameters": {**cfg["context"],"attempt":entity,"param_version":1}}}
        if meta:
            with self.lock: self.metadata[call_id] = meta
        event = Trace(self.pins, entity, entity).record(node, phase, {"param_version": 1},
            lambda: {"inputs": inputs, "outputs": outputs}, call_id=call_id, depends=depends,
            scope="application" if entity == "application" else "entity")
        if not event:
            with self.lock: self.metadata.pop(call_id, None)
        return event

    def bo_sink(self, text):
        event = json.loads(text)
        with self.lock:
            meta = self.metadata.pop(event["call_id"], None)
            if meta:
                event["revision"] = meta["revision"]
                self.frames.append({"event_id": event["id"], "run_id": event["run_id"], "build_id": self.build_id, **meta})
        self.history.append(event)

    def bo_view(self):
        machine = self.bo_machine()
        rows = machine["configurations"]
        current = rows[-1] if rows else None
        with self.lock: frames = deepcopy(list(self.frames))
        return {"layout_id": "gallery-python-trial", "model": self.model, "manifest": self.manifest,
            "binding_status": check(self.root, self.model, self.manifest), "events": self.history.snapshot(), "machine": machine,
            "authority": {"entity": current["attempt"] if current else None, "state": current["phase"] if current else None,
                "basis": {"param_version": 1}, "parameters": {**current["context"],"attempt":current["attempt"],"param_version":1} if current else {}},
            "health": self.pins.health(), "historical": False, "busy": False, "available_cases": ["live"],
            "runtime_frames": {"schema": "stategraph-runtime-frames/v1", "partial": True, "frames": frames}}

    def bo_projection(self):
        machine = self.bo_machine()
        return {"build_id": self.build_id, "machine": machine, "instances": self.graph.bo_instances(machine)}

    def bo_close(self):
        self.pins.flush()
        self.recordings.close()
        self.pins.close()

"""Run the independent gallery on a local interface."""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from app.service import Gallery
from app.web import create_app
from werkzeug.serving import make_server

def build_application(root, database, observe=True):
    database.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    service = Gallery(database, root / "bo_stategraph/project.json")
    app = create_app(service)
    adapter = None
    if observe:
        try:
            from integrations.bo_adapter import BOAdapter
            from integrations.bo_web import bo_attach
            adapter = BOAdapter(root, database)
            adapter.graph.bo_require_definition(service.machine.definition)
            bo_attach(app, adapter, root)
            service.bo, service.build_id = adapter.port, adapter.build_id
        except Exception as error:
            if adapter is not None: adapter.bo_close()
            adapter = None
            print(f"Observer unavailable; business remains available: {type(error).__name__}: {error}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    return app, service, adapter

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8842)
    parser.add_argument("--core", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--database", default="work/gallery.sqlite")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    app, service, adapter = build_application(root, root / args.database, not args.core)
    server = make_server("127.0.0.1", args.port, app, threaded=True)
    print(f"Gallery URL: http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/", flush=True)
    print(f"Graph URL: http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/graph" if adapter else "Graph URL: unavailable (business-only mode)", flush=True)
    try: server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt: pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()
        if adapter is not None: adapter.bo_close()

if __name__ == "__main__": main()

"""Independent application, state, observer isolation, and architecture checks."""
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
import threading
import unittest
import uuid
from app.service import Gallery,DomainError
from app.web import create_app
from app.ports import BOPort
from bo_observe import image_bytes,execute_case,sql_snapshot,login,upload,session_csrf
from integrations.bo_adapter import BOAdapter
from integrations.bo_web import bo_attach

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

class GalleryChecks(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.folder=ROOT/"work/tests"/uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.folder.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.database=self.folder/"gallery.sqlite"

    def test_confirmed_effects_and_observer_failure_isolation(self):
        expected=json.loads((ROOT/"review/evidence/independent-expectations-before-implementation.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for case,fields in expected.items():
            for mode in ["on","off","fault"]:
                with self.subTest(case=case,mode=mode):
                    run,_,_=execute_case(case,mode,self.folder)
                    for key,value in fields.items(): self.assertEqual(run["observations"][key],value)
                    if mode in {"off","fault"}: self.assertEqual(run["events"],[])
                    if mode=="fault": self.assertGreater(run["port_errors"],0)

    def test_real_concurrent_review_serializes_one_decision(self):
        service=Gallery(self.database,ROOT/"bo_stategraph/project.json")
        ident=service.upload("uploader","test.png",image_bytes())["id"]
        barrier=threading.Barrier(2)
        def review(decision):
            barrier.wait()
            try: return service.review("reviewer",ident,decision)["state"]
            except DomainError as exc: return exc.status
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool: results=list(pool.map(review,["approve","reject"]))
        self.assertEqual(sum(x==409 for x in results),1)
        self.assertEqual(sql_snapshot(self.database)[0][0]["revision"],2)
        with sqlite3.connect(self.database) as db: self.assertEqual(db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM journal").fetchone()[0],2)

    def test_content_does_not_follow_filename_and_truncation_rejects(self):
        service=Gallery(self.database,ROOT/"bo_stategraph/project.json")
        service.upload("uploader","notes.txt",image_bytes())
        before=sql_snapshot(self.database)
        with self.assertRaises(DomainError) as rejected: service.upload("uploader","broken.png",image_bytes()[:24])
        self.assertEqual(rejected.exception.status,415)
        self.assertEqual(sql_snapshot(self.database),before)

    def test_observer_controls_do_not_emit_business_events(self):
        adapter=BOAdapter(ROOT,self.database,recording_dir=self.folder/"recordings")
        service=Gallery(self.database,ROOT/"bo_stategraph/project.json",adapter.port,adapter.build_id)
        app=create_app(service);bo_attach(app,adapter,ROOT);client=app.test_client()
        try:
            login(client,"uploader");upload(client)
            adapter.pins.flush();before=len(adapter.history.snapshot())
            configuration=client.get("/api/view").get_json()["machine"]["configurations"][0]
            self.assertIsInstance(configuration["journal"],list)
            self.assertEqual(configuration["param_version"],1)
            view=client.get("/api/view").get_json()
            self.assertTrue(set(view["model"]["machine"]["values"]) <= set(view["model"]["machine"]["labels"]))
            for path in ["/graph","/api/view","/api/design","/api/source?path=app/service.py","/api/preferences","/api/stategraph/export"]:
                self.assertEqual(client.get(path).status_code,200)
            prefs=client.get("/api/preferences").get_json()
            self.assertEqual(client.post("/api/preferences",json=prefs).status_code,200)
            response=client.post("/api/recordings/start",json={})
            self.assertEqual(response.status_code,200)
            record_id=response.get_json()["id"]
            self.assertEqual(client.post("/api/recordings/stop",json={}).status_code,200)
            saved=client.get("/api/recordings/"+record_id).get_json()
            self.assertEqual(saved["events"],[])
            adapter.pins.flush();self.assertEqual(len(adapter.history.snapshot()),before)
            adapter.recordings.start("actual commit")
            ident=service.upload("uploader","second.png",image_bytes())["id"]
            service.review("reviewer",ident,"approve")
            adapter.pins.flush();summary=adapter.recordings.stop();record=adapter.recordings.get(summary["id"])
            self.assertTrue(record["runtime_frames"]["frames"])
            phases=[f["machine"]["configurations"][0]["phase"] for f in record["runtime_frames"]["frames"]]
            self.assertIn("pending",phases);self.assertIn("published",phases)
            self.assertEqual([f["machine"]["current"] for f in record["runtime_frames"]["frames"]],phases)
            self.assertEqual(record["gaps"],[],"Ordinary calls do not require state snapshots")
            from copy import deepcopy
            from observer_runtime.recording_session import Recordings
            negative=deepcopy(record)
            negative.update(id=uuid.uuid4().hex,label="Negative checker fixture: intentionally omitted actual state frame")
            negative["runtime_frames"]["frames"]=negative["runtime_frames"]["frames"][:-1]
            checker=Recordings(self.folder/"negative-recordings",adapter.bo_view,{})
            try:
                checker._save(negative)
                self.assertTrue(any("runtime snapshot" in gap for gap in negative["gaps"]))
            finally: checker.close()
        finally: adapter.bo_close()

    def test_web_hidden_disabled_and_business_survives(self):
        adapter=BOAdapter(ROOT,self.database,recording_dir=self.folder/"recordings")
        service=Gallery(self.database,ROOT/"bo_stategraph/project.json",adapter.port,adapter.build_id)
        app=create_app(service);bo_attach(app,adapter,ROOT);client=app.test_client()
        web=app.config["BO_WEB"]
        try:
            web.set_mode("hidden")
            self.assertIn(b"data-bo-entry hidden",client.get("/").data)
            self.assertEqual(client.get("/graph").status_code,200)
            web.set_mode("disabled")
            for path in ["/graph","/api/view","/api/source","/api/preferences","/api/recordings","/api/stategraph/export"]: self.assertEqual(client.get(path).status_code,404)
            self.assertEqual(service.upload("uploader","alive.png",image_bytes())["state"],"pending")
        finally: web.set_mode("visible");adapter.bo_close()

    def test_bounded_queue_and_payload_builder_failure_leave_business_unchanged(self):
        gate=threading.Event()
        adapter=BOAdapter(ROOT,self.database,capacity=1,recording_dir=self.folder/"recordings")
        original=adapter.pins.sink
        def slow_sink(text): gate.wait(2);original(text)
        adapter.pins.sink=slow_sink
        service=Gallery(self.database,ROOT/"bo_stategraph/project.json",adapter.port,adapter.build_id)
        try:
            service.upload("uploader","queue.png",image_bytes())
            self.assertEqual(len(sql_snapshot(self.database)[0]),1)
            self.assertGreater(adapter.pins.health()["dropped"],0)
            service.bo=BOPort(lambda *args: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError("Injected capture construction failure")))
            self.assertEqual(service.upload("uploader","builder.png",image_bytes())["state"],"pending")
            self.assertGreater(service.bo.errors,0)
        finally: gate.set();adapter.bo_close()

    def test_invalid_declaration_and_invalid_actual_state_are_not_normalized(self):
        from bo_stategraph import BOStateGraph
        from bo_stategraph.workflow import GalleryMachine
        doc=json.loads((ROOT/"bo_stategraph/project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        doc["model"]["machine"]["transitions"][0]["before"]="unsupported callback"
        invalid=self.folder/"invalid.json";invalid.write_text(json.dumps(doc),encoding="utf-8")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): GalleryMachine(invalid)
        original=json.loads((ROOT/"bo_stategraph/project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["model"]
        graph=BOStateGraph(original,build_id="test",mode="drive")
        items=graph.bo_instances({"configurations":[{"attempt":"bad","phase":"made_up","state_revision":1,"run_build_id":"test","context":{"format":"PNG","uploader":"uploader"}}]})
        self.assertEqual(items[0]["observed"]["state"],"made_up")
        self.assertEqual(items[0]["status"],"mismatch")

    def test_actual_callback_and_guard_bindings(self):
        import app.web as web
        from bo_stategraph.workflow import GalleryMachine
        service=Gallery(self.database,ROOT/"bo_stategraph/project.json")
        app=create_app(service)
        with app.app_context(): self.assertIs(web.gallery_service(),service)
        for name in ["login_action","upload_action","review_action","messages_page","image_content","exhibition_page"]:
            self.assertIs(app.view_functions["business."+name],getattr(web,name))
        self.assertIs(service.machine.guards["reviewer"].__func__,GalleryMachine.is_reviewer)
        self.assertIs(service.machine.guards["uploader"].__func__,GalleryMachine.is_uploader)
        self.assertIs(service.machine.guards["content"].__func__,GalleryMachine.valid_content)

    def test_core_application_has_no_debug_entry(self):
        service=Gallery(self.database,ROOT/"bo_stategraph/project.json")
        client=create_app(service).test_client()
        self.assertNotIn(b"data-bo-entry",client.get("/").data)
        self.assertEqual(client.get("/graph").status_code,404)
        self.assertEqual(service.upload("uploader","core.png",image_bytes())["state"],"pending")

    def test_observer_startup_failure_keeps_business_available(self):
        from unittest.mock import patch
        from run import build_application
        with patch("integrations.bo_adapter.BOAdapter",side_effect=OSError("Injected observer startup failure")):
            app,service,adapter=build_application(ROOT,self.database)
        self.assertIsNone(adapter)
        self.assertEqual(app.test_client().get("/").status_code,200)
        self.assertEqual(service.upload("uploader","fallback.png",image_bytes())["state"],"pending")

    def test_broken_observer_web_config_preserves_business_response(self):
        adapter=BOAdapter(ROOT,self.database,recording_dir=self.folder/"recordings")
        service=Gallery(self.database,ROOT/"bo_stategraph/project.json",adapter.port,adapter.build_id)
        app=create_app(service);bo_attach(app,adapter,ROOT)
        app.config["BO_WEB"].config=self.folder/"broken-web.json"
        app.config["BO_WEB"].config.write_text('{"mode":"broken"}',encoding="utf-8")
        try:
            self.assertEqual(app.test_client().get("/").status_code,200)
            self.assertEqual(app.test_client().get("/graph").status_code,503)
            self.assertEqual(service.upload("uploader","alive.png",image_bytes())["state"],"pending")
        finally: adapter.bo_close()

if __name__=="__main__": unittest.main(verbosity=2)

"""Generate one project envelope from confirmed intent and source-first inventory."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from observer_runtime.code_structure import scan, enrich
from observer_runtime.behavior_model import validate
from observer_runtime.bo_observer.protocol import validate_project
from observer_runtime.observation_scope import endpoint_paths

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
def write(name, value):
    (ROOT / name).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (ROOT / name).write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

def generate():
    files = sorted([p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for folder in ("app", "integrations") for p in (ROOT/folder).rglob("*.py")] + ["bo_stategraph/workflow.py", "run.py"])
    index = scan(ROOT, files)
    features, nodes = [], []
    definitions = [
        ("login", "预置账号登录", "action", "app/service.py::Gallery.login", {"username":"string", "password_present":"boolean"}, {"authenticated":"boolean", "role":"string"}, [("approve_png","return"),("bad_login","return")], {"username":("username","value"),"password":("password_present","derived")}),
        ("authorize", "按实际账号角色检查权限", "decision", "app/service.py::Gallery.authorize", {"actor":"string","required":"string"}, {"role":"string","allowed":"boolean"}, [("approve_png","return"),("uploader_review_denied","return")], {"actor":("actor","value"),"required":("required","value")}),
        ("image_check", "解码实际内容：PNG / JPEG", "decision", "app/service.py::Gallery.inspect_image", {"byte_count":"number"}, {"valid":"boolean","format":"string","width":"number","height":"number"}, [("approve_png","return"),("non_image","return"),("unsupported_gif","return")], {"data":("byte_count","derived")}),
        ("upload", "上传并保存待审核图片", "action", "app/service.py::Gallery.upload", {"actor":"string","filename":"string","byte_count":"number"}, {"id":"string","state":"string","revision":"number","sha256":"string"}, [("approve_png","commit")], {"actor":("actor","value"),"filename":("filename","value"),"data":("byte_count","derived")}),
        ("message", "事务提交后：审核者站内消息", "effect", "app/service.py::Gallery.notify", {"image_id":"string"}, {"recipient":"string","message_id":"string"}, [("approve_png","commit")], {"db":(None,"context"),"image_id":("image_id","value")}),
        ("review", "声明驱动：通过 / 驳回", "action", "app/service.py::Gallery.review", {"actor":"string","image_id":"string","decision":"string"}, {"before":"string","state":"string","revision":"number","reviewer_guard":"boolean"}, [("approve_png","commit"),("reject_jpeg","commit")], {"actor":("actor","value"),"image_id":("image_id","value"),"decision":("decision","value")}),
        ("messages", "读取审核者消息列表", "action", "app/service.py::Gallery.messages", {"actor":"string"}, {"count":"number"}, [("approve_png","return")], {"actor":("actor","value")}),
        ("exhibition", "公开画展：仅已通过图片", "action", "app/service.py::Gallery.exhibition", {}, {"count":"number"}, [("approve_png","return")], {}),
        ("image", "读取公开图片 / 审核预览", "action", "app/service.py::Gallery.image", {"image_id":"string","actor":"string"}, {"format":"string","byte_count":"number"}, [("approve_png","return")], {"image_id":("image_id","value"),"actor":("actor","value")})]
    http = {"exhibition_page":("http_exhibition","公开画展页面", "approve_png"), "login_page":("http_login_page","登录页面","approve_png"),
        "login_action":("http_login","提交登录表单","approve_png"), "logout_action":("http_logout","退出账号","approve_png"),
        "upload_page":("http_upload_page","上传页面","approve_png"), "upload_action":("http_upload","提交上传表单","approve_png"),
        "messages_page":("http_messages","消息审核页面","approve_png"), "review_action":("http_review","提交审核表单","approve_png"),
        "image_content":("http_image","图片内容请求","approve_png")}
    for symbol,(ident,label,case) in http.items():
        incoming = {"image_id":"string"} if symbol in {"review_action","image_content"} else {}
        params = {key:(key,"value") for key in incoming}
        definitions.append((ident,label,"action","app/web.py::"+symbol,incoming,{"status":"number"},[(case,"response")],params))
    for ident,label,kind,sid,inputs,outputs,cases,params in definitions:
        path,symbol = sid.split("::")
        parent = {"authorize":"login","messages":"message","image":"exhibition"}.get(ident)
        if ident.startswith("http_"):
            parent = {"http_exhibition":"exhibition", "http_login_page":"login", "http_login":"login", "http_logout":"login", "http_upload_page":"upload", "http_upload":"upload", "http_messages":"message", "http_review":"review", "http_image":"image"}[ident]
        node = {"id":ident,"label":label,"kind":kind,"layer":"business" if not parent else "program",
            "summary":"Confirmed simulated-role scope; actual values come only from the executed function or HTTP response.",
            "source":{"path":path,"symbol":symbol},"capture":{"in":inputs,"out":outputs},"requirements":["R_review"]}
        if parent: node["parent"] = parent
        nodes.append(node)
        disposition = []
        for name,(field,policy) in params.items():
            item = {"source":sid,"name":name,"policy":policy}
            if policy == "context": item["reason"] = "Transaction context, not captured."
            else:
                item.update(node=ident,direction="in",field=field)
                if policy == "derived": item["reason"] = "Capture only byte count or credential presence; never file bytes or credentials."
            disposition.append(item)
        features.append({"id":ident,"label":label,"business_node":parent or ident,"nodes":[ident],"sources":[sid],"parameters":disposition,
            "cases":[{"case":case,"node":ident,"phase":phase} for case,phase in cases]})
    nodes.append({"id":"invalid_file","kind":"effect","parent":"upload","layer":"program","label":"拒绝内容：不保存、不通知","summary":"Invalid content has no image row and no message row.","source":{"path":"app/service.py","symbol":"Gallery.upload"},"capture":{"in":{"format":"string"},"out":{"status":"number","created":"boolean"}}})
    upload = next(f for f in features if f["id"] == "upload")
    upload["nodes"].append("invalid_file")
    upload["cases"].append({"case":"non_image","node":"invalid_file","phase":"reject"})
    states = ["unsubmitted","pending","published","rejected"]
    for state in states:
        nodes.append({"id":state,"kind":"state","layer":"state","value":state,"label":{"unsubmitted":"尚未提交","pending":"待审核","published":"通过并公开","rejected":"驳回不展示"}[state],"summary":"Persisted or initial state defined by the common executable declaration."})
    edges = [{"id":a+"_"+b,"from":a,"to":b,"type":kind,"label":label,"evidence":"Explicit simulated-role answer S_simulated_02; not runtime evidence"} for a,b,kind,label in [
        ("login","upload","guard","上传者"),("login","review","guard","审核者"),("upload","image_check","flow","实际内容"),
        ("image_check","invalid_file","flow","不符合"),("image_check","pending","flow","PNG / JPEG 合格"),("upload","message","flow","同一事务"),
        ("message","messages","flow","审核者读取"),("messages","review","flow","待审图片"),("review","published","flow","通过"),
        ("review","rejected","flow","驳回"),("published","exhibition","guard","仅通过项可公开")]]
    for node in nodes:
        if node.get("parent"): edges.append({"id":"contains."+node["id"],"from":node["parent"],"to":node["id"],"type":"contains","evidence":"Authored implementation ownership","label":"实现"})
    classified = {sid for f in features for sid in f["sources"]}
    support, excluded = {}, {}
    for sid, symbol in index["symbols"].items():
        if symbol["kind"] != "function" or sid in classified: continue
        name = symbol["symbol"].split(".")[-1]
        if symbol["path"].startswith("integrations/") or symbol["path"] == "app/ports.py":
            excluded[sid] = {"category":"observer","reason":"Exact observer-only integration or neutral failure-isolated port; no domain decision."}
            if symbol.get("entrypoints"): excluded[sid]["routes"] = endpoint_paths(symbol)
        elif name == "__init__":
            excluded[sid] = {"category":"construction","reason":"Object construction; domain initialization is separately inventoried."}
        else:
            owner = "review" if symbol["path"] == "bo_stategraph/workflow.py" else "login" if symbol["path"] == "app/web.py" else "upload"
            support[sid] = {"node":owner,"reason":"Source-inventoried support implementation; no runtime success inferred from this classification."}
    implementation = {"schema":"bo-implementation/v1","features":features,"support":support,"excluded":excluded}
    write("implementation.json", implementation)
    machine = {"engine":"bo.fsm","version":"1","states":states,"values":states,"initial":"unsubmitted","state_type":"enum",
        "labels":{"unsubmitted":"尚未提交","pending":"待审核","published":"通过并公开","rejected":"驳回不展示"},
        "context":{"format":{"type":"string"},"uploader":{"type":"string"}},
        "events":{event:{"payload":{"role":{"type":"string"}}} for event in ("submit","approve","reject")},
        "guards":{"uploader":{"node":"authorize"},"reviewer":{"node":"authorize"},"content":{"node":"image_check"}},
        "transitions":[{"source":"unsubmitted","dest":"pending","trigger":"submit","conditions":["uploader","content"]},
            {"source":"pending","dest":"published","trigger":"approve","conditions":["reviewer"]},
            {"source":"pending","dest":"rejected","trigger":"reject","conditions":["reviewer"]}]}
    resources = sorted(p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for p in (ROOT/"app").rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.suffix in {".html",".css"})
    watched = ["intent.json","discovery.json","implementation.json","requirements.txt","tooling/build_model.py","bo_observe.py","test_app.py","validate.py","bo_stategraph/__init__.py","bo_stategraph/bo_contracts.py","bo_stategraph/execution_contract.py","bo_stategraph/runtime-version.json","observer_runtime/architecture_guard.py","ownership.json","mapping.json","whitebox.json"]
    source_files = sorted(set(files+resources+watched))
    model = {"schema_version":3,"revision":"gallery-2","project_id":"gallery-python-trial","title":"画展上传与审核","intent":"intent.json",
        "source_files":source_files,"nodes":nodes,"edges":edges,"overview":[{"node":n["id"]} for n in nodes if not n.get("parent") and n["kind"] != "state"],
        "graph_roots":["login","upload","image_check","message","review","exhibition"],"scope":{"unknowns":["Finite local trial cases; arbitrary dynamic calls and all concurrent schedules are not proven."]},
        "machine":machine,"implementation":implementation,"presentation":{"subject":"画展上传与审核","recording":{"parameters":["format","uploader"]}}}
    model = enrich(model,index,1)
    choice = "选择 drive，基于声明的状态机开发。"
    project = {"protocol":"bo-project/v1","project_id":"gallery-python-trial","selection":{"mode":"drive","source":"user","answer":choice,"locator":"review/answer-02.simulated.original.txt; explicitly simulated test role, not original human requirement"},"model":model}
    write("bo_stategraph/project.json",project)
    cases = sorted({c["case"] for c in json.loads((ROOT/"acceptance.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["checks"]})
    mapping = {"schema":"bo-mapping/v1","cases":cases,"modes":["on","off","fault"],"source":"bo_observe.py independent SQL reads of images table",
        "actual_collection":["authority_rows"],"actual_id":["id"],"fields":[
            {"id":"state","node":"review","actual":["state"],"mapped":["state"]},
            {"id":"revision","node":"review","actual":["revision"],"mapped":["revision"]},
            {"id":"build","node":"upload","actual":["build_id"],"mapped":["build_id"]},
            {"id":"format","node":"image_check","actual":["format"],"mapped":["context","format"]},
            {"id":"uploader","node":"upload","actual":["uploader"],"mapped":["context","uploader"]}],"export":{"case":"approve_png","mode":"on"}}
    write("mapping.json",mapping)
    whitebox = {"schema_version":1,"rules":[{"id":"content-rule","requirement":"R_content","claim":"Actual content determines acceptance","basis":"S_simulated_02 (test role)","category":"decision","node":"image_check","source":{"path":"app/service.py","symbol":"Gallery.inspect_image"}}],
        "checks":[{"id":"valid-png","rule":"content-rule","case":"approve_png","phase":"return","count":{"min":1},"fields":[{"path":["outputs","valid"],"equals":True},{"path":["outputs","format"],"equals":"PNG"}]},
            {"id":"invalid-content","rule":"content-rule","case":"non_image","phase":"return","count":{"min":1},"fields":[{"path":["outputs","valid"],"equals":False}]}]}
    write("whitebox.json", whitebox)
    frozen = {p.relative_to(ROOT/"work").as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (ROOT/"work").rglob("*.py")}
    write("review/historical-tooling-hashes.json",{"files":frozen})
    cfg = {"model":"bo_stategraph/project.json","manifest":"manifest.json","code_files":files,"watch_files":source_files,"discovery":"discovery.json","acceptance":"acceptance.json","whitebox":"whitebox.json","mapping_contract":"mapping.json","require_mapping_witnesses":True,
        "stategraph":{"module":"bo_stategraph/__init__.py","development_mode":"drive","execution_mode":"drive","decision_source":"user","decision":choice},
        "source_scope":{"roots":["."],"require_symbol_classification":True,"exclude":{"observer_runtime/**":"Frozen managed observer runtime; tool fingerprints and managed hashes preserve it.","static/graph/**":"Unmodified frozen viewer assets, managed by bo_upgrade.","tooling/**":"Trial build and command tooling, watched explicitly.","work/**":"Historical preparation scripts and generated runtime files; hashed historical Python sources.","review/**":"Historical evidence, not application implementation.","outputs/**":"Deliverables and verified exports.","bo_stategraph/__init__.py":"Managed public graph module.","bo_stategraph/bo_contracts.py":"Managed public declaration validation.","bo_stategraph/execution_contract.py":"Managed public activity validation.","bo_observe.py":"Independent evidence runner, explicitly watched.","test_app.py":"Independent project checks, explicitly watched.","validate.py":"Project verification entrypoint, explicitly watched."},"frozen_sources":{"work":"review/historical-tooling-hashes.json"}},
        "slice_depth":1,"probe_callees":["self.bo.record"],"required_probes":[{"symbol":"app/service.py::Gallery.upload","node":"upload","phase":"commit"},{"symbol":"app/service.py::Gallery.review","node":"review","phase":"commit"},{"symbol":"app/service.py::Gallery.login","node":"login","phase":"return"}],
        "required_runtime_probes":[{"case":"approve_png","node":"upload","phase":"commit"},{"case":"approve_png","node":"review","phase":"commit"},{"case":"non_image","node":"invalid_file","phase":"reject"}],"probe_modes":["on","off","fault"],"observations_command":["{python}","-B","bo_observe.py"],"test_commands":[["{python}","-B","test_app.py"],["{python}","-B","observer_runtime/architecture_guard.py","check","--root",str(ROOT)]],"timeout_seconds":180}
    write("sync.json",cfg)
    discovery = json.loads((ROOT/"discovery.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    for net in discovery["networks"]:
        for node in net["nodes"]: node["model_nodes"] = [node["id"]]
    for decision in discovery["decisions"]:
        req = {"D_mode":"R_mode","D_identity":"R_identity","D_image":"R_content"}[decision["id"]]
        accepted = json.loads((ROOT/"acceptance.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        checks = [c["id"] for c in accepted["checks"] + accepted.get("model_checks",[]) if c["requirement"] == req]
        if not checks and req == "R_mode":
            acceptance = json.loads((ROOT/"acceptance.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            acceptance["model_checks"].append({"id":"mode-engine","requirement":"R_mode","path":["machine","engine"],"equals":"bo.fsm"})
            write("acceptance.json",acceptance)
            checks=["mode-engine"]
        decision["links"]={"requirements":[req],"model_nodes":[n for n in decision["affects"] if n in {x["id"] for x in model["nodes"]}],"checks":checks}
    write("discovery.json",discovery)
    validate(ROOT,model)
    validate_project(project)
    print(json.dumps({"nodes":len(model["nodes"]),"features":len(features),"source_files":len(files),"source_symbols":len(index["symbols"])}))

if __name__ == "__main__": generate()
